diagnosis.gap: Fetched notification did not invalidate open history when catalog preview/status/activity did not change.

fix: Compare selected-thread notification watermarks before and after existing authenticated refresh; invalidate only on advance. No model or worker activation, no read acknowledgement on fetch.

presentedReadRecovery.limits: Catch-up captures expire after ten minutes and backend retains at most64 per device. Expiry leaves work unseen.
